## Problem and change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and related issue.

## Verification

List checks performed and actual results. For integration tests, include plugin, UISP, RouterOS, and PHP versions. State what could not be tested. Include redacted UI screenshots when relevant.

## Compatibility

Describe changes to API payloads, configuration, stored data, provisioning, dependencies, or upgrade/rollback steps. Write "None" if there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed CONTRIBUTING.md and kept the change focused.
- [ ] Relevant syntax checks and affected lab workflows were run, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Documentation and the Unreleased changelog are updated where needed.
- [ ] No secrets, customer data, runtime files, or generated archives are included.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution and identified third-party code or assets.
- [ ] Security vulnerabilities are reported privately, not disclosed in this PR.
